children.text: We are committed to maintaining the trust and confidence of the visitors to our website. Here you’ll find information on how we treat data we collect from visitors to our website.
You can use the website without disclosing any personal information.
Analytics
This website collects personal data to power our site analytics, including:
• Information about your browser, network, and device• Web pages you visited prior to coming to this website• Your IP address
This information may also include details about your use of this website, including:
• Clicks• Internal links• Pages visited• Scrolling• Searches• Timestamps
We share this information with Squarespace and Google Analytics, our website analytics providers, to learn about site traffic and activity.
Cookies

This website uses cookies and similar technologies, which are small files or pieces of text that download to a device when a visitor accesses a website or app. For information about viewing the cookies dropped on your device, visit The cookies Squarespace uses.

• These functional and required cookies are always used, which allow Squarespace, our hosting platform, to securely serve this website to you.• These analytics and performance cookies are used on this website, as described below, only when you acknowledge our cookie banner. This website uses analytics and performance cookies to view site traffic, activity, and other data.
Forms

When you submit information to this website via webform, we collect the data requested in the webform in order to track and respond to your submissions. We share this information with Squarespace, our online store hosting provider, so that they can provide website services to us. We do not share your information with other third parties. You are entitled to access the personal information that we hold.
Website Visitors
This website is hosted by Squarespace. Squarespace collects personal data when you visit this website, including:
• Information about your browser, network and device• Web pages you visited prior to coming to this website• Web pages you view while on this website• Your IP address
Squarespace needs the data to run this website, and to protect and improve its platform and services. Squarespace analyzes the data in a de-personalized form.
Fonts

This website serves font files from and renders fonts using Google Fonts and Adobe Fonts. To properly display this site to you, these third parties may receive personal information about you, including:
• Information about your browser, network, or device• Information about this site and the page you’re viewing on it• Your IP address
Appointment Booking
When you schedule an appointment by booking on this website, we collect personal information from you to complete the booking. We may collect information like your:
• Name• Email address• Phone number• Details relating to your appointment (for example, who referred you)• Files you uploaded
We share this information with Calendly, our scheduling service provider, so that they can provide online booking services to us.
Embedded Content From Other Websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-part tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.
The Period Of Data Retention

Team Empathy will retain your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your information to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our policies.
Data Amendments
Upon receiving a request from you to update, correct or amend your personal data, we will make the amendments within a period of 7 days from the date that the request was received.
Security

We are committed to taking appropriate measures designed to keep your data secure. All computer equipment that contains client information is password or biometrically protected and is regularly scanned for viruses and malware. Our processes are designed to protect your data from loss, theft, misuse and accidental, unlawful or unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, use and destruction.
Correcting Your Personal Information
Your Rights
Under the Privacy Act 1993, you have the right to access and ask us to correct or delete any of your personal information provided to us in connection with your use of this website. Contact us if:
• you would like to see or change your personal information that you provided, or• you have any concerns regarding your privacy.
If You Have A Privacy Complaint
Every precaution will be taken to avoid a breach of your data. However, if such a breach should occur, it will be documented, assessed as to its severity and appropriate action taken.
If you have any concerns regarding privacy, please email or call us.
If you're not satisfied with our response to any privacy-related concern you may have, you can contact the Privacy Commissioner. Contact details for the Office of the Privacy Commissioner
Changes To This Privacy Notice
We keep our privacy notice under review. This privacy notice was last updated July 2025.

children.text: Zippily helps you set up and optimise Aircall — the cloud phone system built for modern teams. We design and implement call workflows that integrate seamlessly with your existing tech stack, giving your business a smarter, more connected way to communicate.
Aircall helps teams cut down on missed connections by making every call smarter, faster, and trackable. From sales conversations to support interactions, all communication is managed in one place.
Key features
Cloud-based phone system with local and international numbers.
Seamless integrations with leading CRMs and support tools.
Real-time call monitoring, recording, and voicemail transcription.
Intelligent call routing and IVR to connect customers faster.
Live activity feed and instant notifications for every call.
Analytics and dashboards to track team performance and customer engagement.
Scalable setup designed for startups through to enterprise teams.
Aircall + CRM integration

Aircall connects seamlessly with leading CRMs, automatically logging every call, recording, and voicemail directly to the right contact or deal record. Caller details, notes, and follow-up tasks flow instantly into your system without manual data entry.

faqs.question: What is Aircall and how does it integrate with HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Aircall is a cloud-based VOIP phone system designed for teams. Its native HubSpot integration automatically logs calls, tracks conversations, and provides click-to-dial functionality directly from HubSpot. This ensures all communication data is captured in one place for better customer visibility.

faqs.question: Why should I connect Aircall with HubSpot?
faqs.answer: By integrating Aircall with HubSpot, you eliminate manual data entry, gain deeper insights into your sales and support activity, and streamline workflows. Your team can focus on conversations rather than admin, while management benefits from real-time reporting inside HubSpot.

faqs.question: Is Aircall a good fit for New Zealand and Australian businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes — Aircall is cloud-based, which means it works seamlessly across regions. It’s ideal for distributed teams, remote work setups, and businesses scaling across New Zealand and Australia. As a local HubSpot partner, we help ensure the integration is configured correctly for your specific workflows.

faqs.question: Can I customise the Aircall + HubSpot integration to fit my business needs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Beyond the out-of-the-box features, we can tailor the setup with custom properties, automation, and reporting inside HubSpot. This means you don’t just get calls logged — you get actionable insights connected to your wider sales and service process.

faqs.question: How can Zippily help with my Aircall setup?
faqs.answer: As a HubSpot Solutions Partner based in Auckland, we support businesses with both the technical integration and the strategic implementation of Aircall. Whether you need help setting up, training your team, or optimising call data for reporting, we’ll make sure Aircall works as an extension of your HubSpot CRM.

ctaBanner.heading: Keen to know how much value Aircall can bring?
ctaBanner.text: No matter what your CRM is, Aircall + Zippily gives your team the tools to connect smarter and close faster.
